statements.statement: The member has recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The member has known atherosclerotic heart disease
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is medically necessary
The service is to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods
Confirming atrial fibrillation with this study supports appropriate rate or rhythm control management
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
